saw_lines: Shoppers compare a kettle or a drill against several brands before they pay, and they check returns first.
So the sale is decided on the product page, where price, delivery cost and returns must be visible before the basket.
Your site shows 100,000+ orders delivered and 6,500+ products, yet all 6 of your Google ads are still images, so build a few short video ads around a bestselling product line.
ads_1: Short video creative for Google, built on your 6,500+ product range and delivery promise
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram
